product_launches.description: Go1 introduced Morgan, an AI-powered intelligent agent that delivers contextual, in-the-moment learning inside tools like Slack and Microsoft Teams as part of its new product direction for contextual learning.

overview_description.description: GO1 provides a platform that allows companies to upscale their workforce with on-demand training and a dynamic content-driven platform for companies that are Open to Learn. The funding follows an integration with Microsoft Teams, which enables organizations using Teams to learn directly within their workplace ecosystem. Individuals can now find, consume, share, and discuss learning resources from its library of online learning resources.

about_short_description.short_description: GO1 allows companies to upscale their workforce with on-demand training and a dynamic content-driven platform.

product.name: The Go1 Platform
product.description: A cloud-based learning and development platform for managing employee training, content discovery, learner access, and organizational learning programs.

product.name: Go1 Content Library
product.description: A subscription-based catalog of workplace learning content from more than 250 providers, covering compliance, skills development, and professional training in multiple languages.

product.name: Go1 Content Curation
product.description: Tools and services for organizing learning content into curated playlists and training pathways aligned with business, role, skill, or compliance requirements.

product.name: Go1 Reporting & Insights
product.description: Learning analytics capabilities for monitoring course participation, completions, engagement, and progress across an organization’s training programs.

product.name: Go1 Learner Experience
product.description: Employee-facing learning features that support course discovery, personalized access, self-enrollment, and training completion across web and integrated workplace environments.

product.name: Go1 Technology Integrations
product.description: Integration capabilities that connect Go1 learning content and activity with LMS, HRIS, and other workplace technologies, including embedded learning and reporting workflows.
